summary.text: Janelle Anyanonu is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 19 who took office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Anyanonu grew up in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and graduated from Manzano High School.
Anyanonu earned a bachelor's degree in applied sciences from Wayland Baptist University.
In the 2025-2026 session, Anyanonu serves on the State Government, Elections & Indian Affairs Committee.
